title: Horn of Valhalla already-held instance with no variant has no path to establish its type
description: Found in eshyra-olc5.14.1. A Horn of Valhalla inventory row held before the horn-type variants existed has variant_id NULL; use_item and start_effect refuse it (fail-closed). adopt_item only adopts pack_ref IS NULL rows and give_item cannot change an existing row's variant, so there is no path to establish its type. Decide whether a narrow 'establish variant once' path is needed (only matters for pre-existing saves; the Horn was not bindable before).
notes:
2026-10-19 captain: parented under eshyra-olc5 and made to block eshyra-o9bd.14 (user rule 2026-10-14). In scope of the user's olc5.14 decision, which names establishing 'its previously unknown type'. A narrow, one-time path to establish a variant on an already-held pack-bound row with variant_id NULL; no type reselection.
PR #692 merged at reviewed head f013bb25 (Sol eshyra-0xaq.3 S1 repaired; eshyra-0xaq.4 no material findings).
